integrity: Finite experiments are supplementary to a proof for all finite chain sizes. Literature comparisons identify structural prior ingredients and known recurrence. An equivalent formulation under other terminology remains possible; external verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two ordered, separately monadic Gödel quantifier pairs over one fixed finite chain; same-polarity commutation only. The numerical recurrence is independently known as OEIS A007070. No mixed-polarity, full polyadic, or nonchain classification is claimed.
title: Commuting monadic quantifiers on finite Gödel chains: gap normal form and exact census
